file: 378 RIVALS Was Supposed to Be a Zombie Game.mp4

lines.t: RIVALS was never supposed to be a shooter. It was supposed to be a zombie game.

full.credit: Clips: MiniBloxia; OTTER ON ROBLOX; Breadian (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Nosniy Games first planned it as a zombie wave game, where you fight off hordes together.

full.credit: Clips: MiniBloxia; OTTER ON ROBLOX; Breadian (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Then in late 2023, the lead programmer played a remake of an old Roblox game called Zombie Tower. And they switched to player versus player.

full.credit: Clips: MiniBloxia; OTTER ON ROBLOX; Breadian (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: RIVALS came out in 2024. It almost hit one million players at the same time.

full.credit: Clips: MiniBloxia; OTTER ON ROBLOX; Breadian (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Would RIVALS be better as a zombie game?

full.credit: Clips: MiniBloxia; OTTER ON ROBLOX; Breadian (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
